name: RDP Manager
author: cahva
description: Saved RDP connections in the Omarchy bar. Connect with one click, watch live session state, and keep passwords in the system keyring instead of the process list.

barWidget.description: Saved RDP connections and live session state

schema.label: Notify when a session ends
schema.description: Send a desktop notification when an RDP session disconnects, including the reason when it ended unexpectedly.

schema.label: Hide the icon when idle
schema.description: Keep the bar icon out of the way unless a session is connecting or connected. The panel stays reachable over IPC.
